name: r4-q4-clock-blob-tz
description: Fix Q4 (review A2 B2): runClockTick formats the FPort 12 clock in v.schedule_timezone || v.zone_timezone || gatewayTimezone || 'UTC'. A BLOB is a truthy Buffer: X'' and invalid UTF-8 format in UTC, CAST('Europe/Zurich' AS BLOB) in Zurich; 0 is stored as TEXT '0' and formats in UTC; empty TEXT falls through to the gateway. West phase (gateway Etc/GMT+12, valves A1..A6), then east phase (gateway Pacific/Kiritimati, valves B1..B6). The offsets differ at every hour of the run.
